options.name: items
options.description: Items: action (with optional submenu items), checkbox, radio, separator, and group. Ids are unique across the whole tree.

options.name: label
options.description: Menu aria-label. Default: the menu is labelled by the trigger (aria-labelledby).

options.name: renderItem
options.description: Custom item content (since 0.9.0); the label stays the accessible name and typeahead text. Nodes are reused per item and released with releaseNode when dropped.

options.name: icons
options.type: Partial<{ submenu: IconRef; checked: IconRef; radio: IconRef }>

options.name: placement
options.description: Top-level popup placement relative to the trigger. Submenus always use right-start (left-start in RTL).

options.name: closeOnSelect
options.description: Close after activating a checkbox or radio item. Action items always close the menu.

options.name: typeahead
options.description: Printable characters move focus to the next item whose label starts with them.

options.name: direction
options.description: Submenu side, submenu arrow keys, and chevron mirroring.

properties.name: element
properties.description: Top-level role=menu popup (popover=manual), inserted after the trigger.

properties.name: isOpen
properties.description: Whether the top-level menu is open.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Open and focus the first (default) or last enabled item.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close all levels; focus returns to the trigger when it was inside the menu. No aui-select.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; new items reset checkbox/radio state and close open submenus.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Close, remove all popups, trigger attributes, listeners, and subscriptions.

events.name: aui-select
events.detail: { id: string; item: MenuSelectableItem; checked?: boolean }
events.description: Dispatched on the trigger when the user activates an enabled item. checked is the new state for checkbox and radio items.

events.name: aui-open
events.description: Dispatched on the menu element after the top level opened.

events.name: aui-close
events.description: Dispatched on the menu element after all levels closed.

cssClasses.name: aui-menu--has-check
cssClasses.description: Level contains checkbox/radio items; reserves the check column.
